hint: Error Details

label: Target Object Name

label: column1Name
name: column1Name
hint: Please populate this field to pass the table in the notification

label: Calling recipe ID
name: calling_recipe_id
hint: Callable trigger › Context › Calling recipe ID. Blank = read from Job URL.

label: Calling job ID
name: calling_job_id
hint: Callable trigger › Context › Calling job ID. Blank = read from Job URL.

label: Error file path
name: error_file_path
hint: Create file › Path (file storage). Saved to the error log.

label: Error file link expires in (s)
name: error_file_expires_in
hint: Generate shareable file link › Expires in. Used for 'Sharable Link Expires on'.

label: Workato API token
name: workato_api_token
hint: Reads the error log table, the failing job and recipe, and repeats jobs. Blank = no history, no job context, no auto-retry.

label: Azure OpenAI API key
name: azure_api_key
hint: Writes the explanation and decides if the job is reprocessable (replaces Genie). Blank = built-in playbook and rules.

label: Look
name: look
hint: Blank = new look. Old = current_email.html + moustache table.

label: Header layout
name: hero_layout
hint: Blank = new: Coursera + team logo, then one row of pills (priority, retry verdict, category, repeats, records, time), then the recipe name. Classic = the previous header: plain-text priority line, pills under the headline, one logo. Only used when Look = new.

label: Show error alert banner
name: error_banner
hint: Blank = yes. A red strip with a cross and 'Error alert' at the very top of the email, so it reads as an error at a glance. No = leave it out.

label: Hover effects
name: hover_effects
hint: Blank = yes. Built into the email (no w3.css needed): cards lift with a soft shadow, table rows tint with a blue bar, pills, buttons, chart bars and job squares react under the mouse. They show wherever the mail client allows hover styles; on phones there is no hover, so nothing changes there. No = leave the effects out.

label: Row hover colour
name: hover_row_color
hint: Blank = pale blue #EEF4FF. The colour a table row (failed records, recent failures) and the other list rows turn under the mouse. To match the health check mail use the pale green #DDFFDD.

label: Detail level
name: detail
hint: Blank = standard. How much the email shows. brief: hero,error,records,actions; standard: hero,error,records,story,signals,history,actions; full: hero,error,records,flow,kpis,story,signals,history,job,details,actions. Map it from priority in the recipe, e.g. Critical = full, Medium = brief. Then add or remove sections with the inputs below.

label: Environment
name: env
hint: Account property env: prod, dev, test… Sets the frame colour and subject.

label: Sections (order)
name: sections
hint: Optional. Replaces the whole list (ignores Detail level): comma-separated, in the order you want. Names: hero = header: priority, recipe name, one-line headline, pills, greeting; error = the error message (facts such as Total Records are laid out as a small table); records = the failed records table, with error-code counts; flow = Source > Workato step > Target, with the failing hop marked; kpis = thin number tiles under it: records processed, failed, success rate, retries, runs with errors, retry success; story = what happened: in plain words, under the hood, likely cause, next steps; signals = things worth knowing: reprocessable?, retry result, recipe changed recently, same error elsewhere; history = failure history of this recipe: trend, 30-day chart, recent similar failures, most common errors; job = Workato job and recipe: status, duration, slowest step, recipe state, last jobs; details = technical details: failure, Workato ids (links), systems, handling; actions = buttons: view job, open recipe, error file, runbook, error log. Also accepted: buttons = actions, links = actions, technical = details, tech = details, message = error, pipeline = flow, header = hero, trend = history, workato = job, tiles = kpis, table = records, rows = records, insights = signals, summary = story, explanation = story.

label: Add sections
name: show_sections
hint: Comma-separated sections to ADD to the Detail level, e.g. kpis,details. Names: hero = header: priority, recipe name, one-line headline, pills, greeting; error = the error message (facts such as Total Records are laid out as a small table); records = the failed records table, with error-code counts; flow = Source > Workato step > Target, with the failing hop marked; kpis = thin number tiles under it: records processed, failed, success rate, retries, runs with errors, retry success; story = what happened: in plain words, under the hood, likely cause, next steps; signals = things worth knowing: reprocessable?, retry result, recipe changed recently, same error elsewhere; history = failure history of this recipe: trend, 30-day chart, recent similar failures, most common errors; job = Workato job and recipe: status, duration, slowest step, recipe state, last jobs; details = technical details: failure, Workato ids (links), systems, handling; actions = buttons: view job, open recipe, error file, runbook, error log. Also accepted: buttons = actions, links = actions, technical = details, tech = details, message = error, pipeline = flow, header = hero, trend = history, workato = job, tiles = kpis, table = records, rows = records, insights = signals, summary = story, explanation = story.

label: Hide sections
name: hide_sections
hint: Comma-separated sections to REMOVE, e.g. history,signals. Names: hero = header: priority, recipe name, one-line headline, pills, greeting; error = the error message (facts such as Total Records are laid out as a small table); records = the failed records table, with error-code counts; flow = Source > Workato step > Target, with the failing hop marked; kpis = thin number tiles under it: records processed, failed, success rate, retries, runs with errors, retry success; story = what happened: in plain words, under the hood, likely cause, next steps; signals = things worth knowing: reprocessable?, retry result, recipe changed recently, same error elsewhere; history = failure history of this recipe: trend, 30-day chart, recent similar failures, most common errors; job = Workato job and recipe: status, duration, slowest step, recipe state, last jobs; details = technical details: failure, Workato ids (links), systems, handling; actions = buttons: view job, open recipe, error file, runbook, error log. Parts you can hide on their own: story.causes, story.steps, history.chart, history.recent, history.common, job.recent, details.failure, details.workato, details.systems, details.handling. Example: story.steps,history.chart. Also accepted: buttons = actions, links = actions, technical = details, tech = details, message = error, pipeline = flow, header = hero, trend = history, workato = job, tiles = kpis, table = records, rows = records, insights = signals, summary = story, explanation = story.

label: Subject format
name: subject_format
hint: Default {emoji} {env} | {subject} (same as today). Also: {recipe} {priority} {category} {recurring} {occurrence} {failed} {total} {signature}

label: Show intro
name: show_intro
hint: Blank = no: the email opens straight on the error. Yes = add the greeting and the 'We caught an error in the <recipe> recipe…' line first. A mail message passed in mail_msg always shows, as one plain line.

label: Greeting
name: greeting
hint: Default: Hi Team,. Only used when Show intro = yes.

label: Time zone
name: timezone
hint: Default America/Los_Angeles (PST/PDT).

label: Brand colour
name: brand_color
hint: Hex, default #0056D2

label: Max width (px)
name: max_width
hint: Blank = auto: 800, and wider when the failed-records table has 4 or 5 columns (920 / 1,040), so the columns keep room. A number (480 to 1,200) fixes it. The card is fluid, so a phone still shows it at full width.

hint: Account property coursera-logo-url

label: Error log table ID
name: data_table_id
hint: Default c1444a9a-03a7-4c82-8618-7796b7384b37 (Error Notification - TBL)

label: History rows (JSON)
name: history_rows_json
hint: Optional: rows from a Search rows step, as JSON. Used instead of the API.

name: job_context

label: Workato API base

label: Show who changed the recipe
name: show_editor
hint: Blank = no

label: Show developer

hint: Blank = no. Yes = look up who wrote the recipe (the first version by a coursera.org address) and show the name in Technical details. Needs the Workato API token and one or two API calls.

label: Use Azure OpenAI
name: ai
hint: Blank = yes (when the key is set)

name: ai_max_tokens

label: Redact before sending to Azure
name: ai_redact
hint: Blank = yes: emails, URLs, Salesforce IDs, long numbers

label: AI team notes
name: ai_instructions
hint: Extra context for Azure, e.g. how your team reprocesses, owners of each system.

label: Auto-escalate priority
name: auto_escalate
hint: Blank = no. Raises one level when it keeps happening.

label: Escalate after (7 days)
name: escalate_after
hint: Default 5 occurrences

label: Log the error to the data table
name: log_row
hint: Blank = yes. The step upserts the error log row into the data table 'Error Notification - TBL' (key: Master Job ID, as the old recipe did) before the email is built, also for calls with frequency / error_limit. The Workato API token must be allowed to write data table records. No = nothing is written; the row is still returned in table_row.

toggle_field.label: Log the error to the data table
toggle_field.name: log_row

label: Retry decision by
name: reprocess_policy
hint: Blank = Azure only. If Azure gives no answer the job is not retried. Rules only = the built-in list of temporary errors.

label: Min Azure confidence to retry
name: reprocess_min_confidence
hint: Blank = medium

label: Auto-retry
name: auto_reprocess
hint: Blank = YES. For every error Azure says whether a re-run would help (only Azure decides; the caller's Reprocess input is ignored). When it says yes the master job is repeated through the Workato API, at most Max auto-retries times, and never when the run is itself a retry. If Azure says no or gives no answer, or the retry could not be started, the error is emailed. No = nothing is retried and Azure is not asked.

label: Max auto-retries per job
name: max_auto_repeats
hint: Default 1: how many times one job is repeated

label: Email even when reprocessable
name: email_when_reprocessable
hint: Blank = no: a retried error is only logged. Yes = also email it.

label: Email when auto-retry fails
name: notify_on_repeat_failure
hint: Blank = yes

label: Max table rows
name: max_table_rows
hint: Default 25

label: Max error characters
name: max_error_chars
hint: Default 3000

label: Max signals
name: max_signals
hint: Default 6

label: Time budget (s)
name: time_budget
hint: Default 45: all API calls share it

label: HTTP timeout (s)
name: http_timeout
hint: Default 12 per call

label: HTML size limit (KB)
name: html_limit_kb
hint: Default 100: Gmail clips at ~102 KB

label: Always build the email
name: always_render
hint: Blank = no. A call that sets frequency / error_limit is only logged, so by default the step skips the lookups and the html (no email goes out). Yes = build the email anyway.

label: Config JSON
name: config_json
hint: Any setting above, plus titles, severity, env_colors, playbook, runbooks, category_rules, app_names, buttons, table_columns

label: Now (testing)
name: now
hint: ISO time to render as. Leave blank.
